rules: Same character, same sit pose, same paws/tail, same framing, same background in every frame.
Only face and emotion props change across A→B→C.
No camera move, no body move, no bob.

neutral.a: Soft calm face, tiny smile, eyes normal open
neutral.b: Same pose, eyes half-closed soft blink
neutral.c: Eyes open again, calm tiny smile

happy.c: Biggest smile, tiny eye sparkle, no big props

laughing.a: Eyes almost closed, open laugh mouth

funny.a: Hard laugh with tiny joy tears at eye corners

sad.c: Small tear forming under one eye

angry.a: Tiny fire or red glow in eyes, frown
angry.b: Larger fire in eyes, stronger furrowed brows
angry.c: Fire bigger than pupils rising from eyes, max glare

loving.c: Hearts bigger than the eyes floating around head

embarrassed.b: Heavy blush plus small sweat drop
embarrassed.c: Max blush plus big sweat drop

surprised.c: Max wide eyes and big O mouth

shocked.a: Terrified wide eyes and open mouth
shocked.b: Bigger scream mouth plus small shock lines
shocked.c: Max scream plus bold shock marks

thinking.a: Eyes look up and aside, mild frown
thinking.c: Tiny thought dots or small thought bubble near head

winking.c: Full wink one eye closed, other eye open

cool.b: Sunglasses with a soft lens gleam
cool.c: Stronger smirk plus brighter lens flash

relaxed.c: Very calm peaceful face, still relaxed not sleeping

delicious.c: Big drool plus tongue tip, yummy face

kissy.c: Big floating hearts larger than eyes, strong kiss face

silly.c: Full silly tongue out plus wink

confused.c: Small swirl or question mark above head
